messages:
maria: quick check — I finished the safetensors conversion for polaris13b but seeing a mismatch on expected shard count when trying to validate on staging. weights are at s3://rw-weights/polaris13b/v1/
ari: which layout did you use? tp_layout or shard-per-device? we expect tp=4 for this model, so 4 shards normally.
maria: I used the conversion script with `--tp 4 --shard-policy=round-robin` — the bucket has files: polaris-00001.safetensors ... polaris-00005.safetensors (5 files) :confused:
devon: that screams mixed sharding. maybe an extra index file or tokenizer got saved as a shard by mistake. can you ls the bucket with `aws s3 ls` and paste names?
maria: pasted listing in thread: ```
2026-03-16 12:05:01    342123 polaris-00001.safetensors
2026-03-16 12:05:01    341998 polaris-00002.safetensors
2026-03-16 12:05:02    342000 polaris-00003.safetensors
2026-03-16 12:05:02    342100 polaris-00004.safetensors
2026-03-16 12:05:03    10234  polaris-tokenizer.json
``` 
ari: ah — tokenizer json ended up in the same prefix and got counted by the packer. convert-bot should ignore non-*.safetensors but we had a bug in the packer glob.
convert-bot: conversion CI: passed with warnings — non-safetensors files detected in weights prefix. Suggestion: move tokenizer to `s3://rw-weights/polaris13b/v1/tokenizer/` and rerun `rwi-convert --clean-prefix`
maria: moving tokenizer now. question: while converting I used dtype=bf16 because training was bf16 but infra wants fp16 for current kernels. any gotchas switching to fp16?
sasha: watch out for numeric stability on layernorm params and output logits. we normally run the fp16 quantize with `--clip-norm 1e-6` and run one eval on a small promptset. also confirm `softmax_temperature` not accidentally changed in the config.
devon: also check kv-cache dtype mismatch — runtime expects kv cache in fp16 for our kernels; if model params are fp16 but kv saved as bf16 you may get dtype-cast overhead. the validate tool warns but doesn't fail.
maria: run this locally to validate:
```
rwi-validate --model polaris13b \
  --weights s3://rw-weights/polaris13b/v1/ \
  --tp 4 --dtype fp16 --tokenizer s3://rw-weights/polaris13b/v1/tokenizer/
```
ari: +1. also include `--expected-shards 4` to make the validator fail fast if count != 4.
convert-bot: note: we flipped default `--tp` inference fallback to prefer lower TP variants for small requests (ticket #1234). if you need strict pinning add `pin_tp=true` to the model config.
maria: ran validator after moving tokenizer — now passes shard count and dtype, but there's a tokenizer quirk: tokenizer has `unk_token` set to `<unk>` but the model uses `<UNK>` in training. token IDs differ by case.
devon: lowercase vs uppercase unknowns will cause embedding mismatch. quick workaround: add mapping in tokenizer config:
```
"special_tokens_map": {"unk_token": "<UNK>"}
```
then run `rwi-validate --reindex-tokenizer` to check token-id alignment.
sasha: once tokenizer mapping applied, please kick a small smoke inference on staging (100 requests, short prompts) to confirm logits look sane and latency/kv behavior is ok.
maria: doing smoke now, will post results.
build-bot: smoke tests queued on staging-serve-3 (tp=4 pool). ETA ~10m.
ari: if smoke passes, tag the weights with `polaris13b-v1-ready` and open a docs PR with the config snippet (include tp, dtype, tokenizer path, pinning).
maria: smoke passed ✅ — no perf regressions, logits distribution matches baseline. I tagged weights and filed PR #782 to docs.
convert-bot: automated checklist updated: conversion->onboarded. closing thread if no blockers.
ari: thanks team :tada:
